# Emit Wiki Content

The Emit Wiki Content feature allows for rerunning only the emission of wiki content based on previously compiled knowledge, without altering the underlying data. This serves to update the documentation without necessitating a full recompilation.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.emit_only`
